title: GPT-6 Pro proves an optimal anticoncentration bound for polynomial Littlewood–Offord inequalities
summary: The source presents a proof discovered autonomously by GPT-6 Pro establishing an O_d(r^{-1/2}) zero-probability bound for degree-d multilinear polynomials with r disjoint degree-d monomials, improving the prior bound by removing a polylogarithmic factor and resolving the Nguyen–Vu conjecture. The key argument also proves a total-influence estimate for bounded-degree rational functions, resolving a recent conjecture of Kothari, Kovacs-Deak, Wang and Yang; these are one connected paper-level result, not separate entries.
organization: Alexandr Grebennikov (affiliation not stated in arXiv record)
